The more you avoid fear, the smaller your world becomes. And the smaller your world gets, the more fearful you can become.
Tony Robbins explains why real-life experience builds confidence in ways that simply thinking about something never can. Stop letting fear decide what you're willing to experience.

fulltitle: Your Fear Is Making Your World Smaller
